title: Cheaply made, came completely broken
text: Cheaply made, came completely broken. Came completely broken. The center part was unscrewed from each corner and the frame was cracked. I’m returning for a refund. Shows how cheaply this is made. The whole thing literally came apart inside the box

product_metadata.title: Stratton Home Décor Stratton Home Decor Framed Metal Flower, 15.75" W X 2.75" D X 15.75" H, Dark Walnut, Grey
features: Measures 15. 75" W x 2. 75" D x 15. 75" H
Wipe clean with a soft cloth
description: Decorate your home with countryside appeal using the handcrafted Grey Framed Metal Flower by Stratton Home Decor. Perfectly layered metal petals in a muted neutral color catch the light and cast a shadow effect as though the sun is shining upon it. The simple narrow walnut-color wood frame has a distressed finish giving it that perfect rustic feel. Combine it with other farmhouse-style decor to create a stunning display. Measures 15. 75" W x 2. 75" D x 15. 75" H and includes a saw tooth hook on the back for hanging ease.
